     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%subsentential alignment using substring counts%' THEN 3
     WHEN p.title ILIKE '%translational innovation in medicine and complexity%' THEN 2

query: semeval, rtm at semeval 2016 task predicting semantic referential translation machines related statistics, koc university
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.corpus_id,
       p.title,
       p.abstract,
       p.canonical_venue,
       p.venue,
       p.year,
       p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE (
    (p.title ILIKE '%semeval%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%semeval%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%rtm%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%rtm%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%referential translation machine%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%semantic%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%semantic%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%task%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%task%')
)
AND (
    p.year = 2016
    OR p.title ILIKE '%2016%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%2016%'
)
AND (
    i.display_name ILIKE '%koc university%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%koc university%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%koc university%'
)
ORDER BY
    (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%semeval 2016%' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%task%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN i.display_name ILIKE '%koc university%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN p.year = 2016 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
    p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

  AND (i.country_code = 'US' OR i.display_name ILIKE '%United States%')

   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%convolutional neural network%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
